page.intro: Your privacy duties, the notices people read and acknowledge, the DPIA and the record of processing.
page.noPublic: No public notice is published yet.
page.noAccess: You need: See privacy & notices. Ask an administrator.
page.noCompany: Your role reaches no company's privacy records.

sample.title: Sample texts
sample.body: The notices, the DPIA and the register on this page hold SAMPLE texts until the privacy consultant writes the real ones. Do not hand them to anyone as final.
sample.dialogBodyPublished: The privacy consultant writes the real notice; it then comes into force as a new version, and everyone acknowledges it again.
sample.dialogBody: Publish it only for a trial: the privacy consultant writes the real notice. A published version never changes; a new version replaces it.

duties.title: Your privacy duties
duties.later: Data requests (access, erasure) and retention rules come in a later step.

register.name: Record of processing and processors
register.done_one: {count} processing activity is in the record, with its processors.
register.done_other: {count} processing activities are in the record, with their processors.
register.needs: The record is empty: add what the company processes and who processes it for you.

publicNotice.name: Public privacy notice
publicNotice.done: Version {label} is published at the company's public address, linked from link pages and e-mails.
publicNotice.needs: No public notice is published: link pages and e-mails point to an empty page.

staffNotice.name: Notice for office staff
staffNotice.done: Version {label} is in force: each office person sees it once at sign-in.
staffNotice.needs: No staff notice is published: office staff are not told what the system keeps about them.

dpia.name: Impact assessment (DPIA)
dpia.law: GDPR art. 35: before the processing starts
dpia.review: DPIA version {version} is stored; its review was due on {date}. Store the reviewed version.
dpia.gates: Floor sign-in with a badge and scans that record workers stay off until a DPIA is stored.

workerNotice.name: Worker notice, acknowledged by every worker
workerNotice.done: Version {label} is in force: each worker acknowledges it on the tablet before their first scan.
workerNotice.gates: Floor work that records workers stays off until one is published.

floor.title: May each site's floor start?
floor.intro: Real floor work (badge sign-ins and scans that record people) waits for the company's privacy duties and the site's floor rules.
floor.noSites: This company has no site yet.

site.ready: The privacy duties and the floor rules are in place.
site.noDpia: Floor sign-in stays off until the DPIA is stored.
site.noNotice: Floor sign-in stays off until a worker notice is published.
site.noBasis: The site names workers in its floor records, but no legal basis is on record.

WORKER_FLOOR.name: Worker notice
WORKER_FLOOR.means: What the floor tools record about workers. Each worker reads and acknowledges it on the tablet before their first scan; until then no scan names them.

OFFICE_STAFF.name: Staff notice
OFFICE_STAFF.who: Shown once to each office person
OFFICE_STAFF.means: What the system keeps about office staff. Each office person sees it once at their next sign-in.

PRIVACY_PUBLIC.name: Public privacy notice
PRIVACY_PUBLIC.means: The notice anyone can read at the company's public address, linked from every link page and e-mail.

notices.workerIntro: Publishing a new version asks every worker again at their next floor sign-in.
notices.empty: No worker notice yet: floor sign-in waits for one.
notices.otherIntro: One of each per company; a new version replaces the one in force.

notice.title: Notice
notice.pdfLanguage: This language is a PDF: workers read it on paper from HR, the tablet shows Italian or English.
notice.missing: Write these languages before publishing: {languages}. The screens show the notice in them.
notice.addLanguageIntro: A worker's own language as a PDF (the paper copy HR hands out), or as text.
notice.dropPdf: The notice in {language}, as a PDF
notice.textAdded: Type the text in {language} above and save it.
notice.deleteConfirm: Delete draft {label}? Its texts are removed; nobody has seen it.

publishMeans.WORKER_FLOOR: Once published, every worker reads and acknowledges it on the tablet at their next sign-in; until then no scan or cut log names them.

ack.title: Who acknowledged it
ack.namesHere: Names are shown here, inside this one notice only, sorted by name: never a ranking.
ack.countsOnly: Counts only: names are shown to people who manage privacy.

paper.title: A signed paper copy
paper.intro: A worker who signed the paper copy in their language: record it here, for the version in force.
paper.everyone: Every worker has acknowledged this version.

newNotice.title: New notice version
newNotice.label: Version label
newNotice.labelHint: As people see and acknowledge it, for example 2026-10.
newNotice.copy: Start from the texts in force
newNotice.after: It starts as a draft: nobody sees it until you publish it.

dpia.why: The impact assessment of floor tracking (GDPR art. 35). The floor gate opens when a signed DPIA is stored.
dpia.signedByHint: As the signed document names them.
dpia.reviewHint: When it must be reviewed (GDPR art. 35(11)).
dpia.none: Badge sign-ins and scans that record workers stay off until a signed DPIA is stored.
dpia.draftIntro: Upload the signed PDF, say who signed it and when, then store it. Storing replaces the version in force.
dpia.newIntro: Start a new version when the processing changes (a new site, a new floor tool) or at its review.
dpia.noDraft: No draft. People who manage privacy start one.
dpia.dropPdf: The DPIA as signed, in PDF
dpia.scopeHint: Left empty: Nexus writes the standard scope (floor tools and office staff data).
dpia.after: It starts as a draft; the version in force stays until you store this one.

register.title: Record of processing activities
register.intro: What personal data the company processes, why, how long and with whom (GDPR art. 30). Processors with their region (art. 28).
register.empty: Add what the company processes: floor scans, staff history, mail with customers and suppliers.

form.codeHint: Capitals, digits, dots or dashes; it never changes. For example FLOOR-SCANS.
form.name: Activity
form.processorsHint: One per line, with its region, for example: E-mail service — EU (Ireland).
form.listRule: Each entry is a word or a short phrase.
form.codeRule: Capitals, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, at most 40.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.body: It stays in the record as archived, for the history, and can no longer change.

held.manage: Needs the right: Manage privacy & notices
held.unsaved: Save the languages you typed first.
held.draftExists: Draft {label} of this notice is open: edit it, publish it or delete it first.
held.label: Give the version a label of at most 40 characters.
held.labelTaken: This notice already has a version {label}.
held.paperWorkerOnly: Only the worker notice is acknowledged on paper.
held.paperInForce: A paper copy is recorded for the version in force.
held.pickWorker: Pick the worker who signed it.
held.dpiaSigner: Say who signed it, as the document names them.
held.dpiaSignedOnMissing: Say the day it was signed.
held.dpiaSignedOn: The signing day is today or earlier.
held.dpiaReviewMissing: Say when it must be reviewed.
held.dpiaReview: The review day comes after the signing day.
held.upload: Uploading files needs the right to upload files.

stepUp.title: Confirm with a fresh code
stepUp.publish: Publishing a notice puts it in force for everyone: type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.dpia: Storing the signed DPIA opens the floor gate: type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

done.pdfAdded: The PDF in {language} is on the draft.

published.WORKER_FLOOR: Version {label} is in force. Every worker reads and acknowledges it on the tablet at their next sign-in.
published.OFFICE_STAFF: Version {label} is in force. Each office person sees it once at their next sign-in.
published.PRIVACY_PUBLIC: Version {label} is in force at the company's public address.

done.paper: The signed paper copy is recorded.
done.paperAgain: That paper copy was recorded already.
done.dpiaPdf: The signed PDF is on the draft.
done.dpiaStored: DPIA version {n} is stored and in force.

problem.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to go on.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not see or do this.
problem.notFound: It no longer exists, or it belongs to another company.
problem.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile. It was read again: check it and try once more.
problem.invalid: Something in it was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.
problem.unavailable: The factory server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.internal: Something went wrong. Try again; if it happens again, tell the administrator.
problem.stepUpClosed: Not done: the code was not given.
problem.copy: The address could not be copied: select it and copy it by hand.
